subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): guard assertHttpUrlTargetsPrivateNetwork against malformed URLs

question: Should the public plugin SDK standardize malformed URL failures from `assertHttpUrlTargetsPrivateNetwork` to a sanitized `TypeError("Invalid URL")` with `code: "ERR_INVALID_URL"` and without Node parser metadata?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes observable properties of a public error object; source-level correctness cannot determine whether downstream plugins are entitled to inspect Node-specific metadata.

options.title: Accept the sanitized SDK contract
options.body: Approve the stable `TypeError` and `ERR_INVALID_URL` surface while excluding credential-bearing native parser fields from the public error graph.

options.title: Preserve additional metadata through a safe contract
options.body: Specify a separate redacted structured field only if downstream plugins need malformed-input diagnostics beyond the current code and message.

recommendation.title: Accept the sanitized SDK contract
recommendation.body: Approve the stable `TypeError` and `ERR_INVALID_URL` surface while excluding credential-bearing native parser fields from the public error graph.
